source: Hand-curated vocabulary across Genki II lessons 13–23 (Banno et al.).
notes: Vocabulary from Genki II, organized by lesson (L13–L23). Genki II shifts into intermediate territory: potential and conditional forms (L13–L14), volitional and travel (L15), giving/receiving (L16), hearsay (L17), causatives (L18), honorific and humble keigo (L19–L20), passive (L21), causative-passive (L22), and abstract/societal topics (L23). Cards skip items already covered in earlier decks where possible, but include them with new context when the Genki lesson treats them as new vocabulary or grammar fixtures.

お + verb stem + する. お持ちする, お送りする.
